# New-ZbxMediaType

## SYNOPSIS

Creates a media type.

## SYNTAX

```
New-ZbxMediaType [[-Name] <string>] [[-Type] <ZabbixMediaTypeKind>] [-SmtpServer <string>] [-SmtpHelo <string>] [-SmtpEmail <string>] [-ScriptName <string>] [-GsmModem <string>] [-UserName <string>] [-Password <SecureString>] [-Status <ZabbixMediaTypeStatus>] [-SmtpPort <string>] [-SmtpSecurity <ZabbixSmtpSecurity>] [-SmtpVerifyPeer <bool>] [-SmtpVerifyHost <bool>] [-SmtpAuthentication <ZabbixSmtpAuthentication>] [-Provider <ZabbixMediaTypeEmailProvider>] [-ScriptParameters <string>] [-MaxSessions <int>] [-MaxAttempts <int>] [-AttemptInterval <string>] [-ContentType <ZabbixMediaMessageFormat>] [-MessageFormat <ZabbixMediaMessageFormat>] [-Script <string>] [-Timeout <string>] [-ProcessTags <bool>] [-ShowEventMenu <ZabbixEventMenu>] [-EventMenuUrl <string>] [-EventMenuName <string>] [-Description <string>] [-Parameter <ZabbixMediaTypeParameterRequest[]>] [-MessageTemplate <ZabbixMediaTypeMessageTemplateRequest[]>] [-RedirectionUrl <string>] [-ClientId <string>] [-ClientSecret <SecureString>] [-AuthorizationUrl <string>] [-TokenUrl <string>] [-TokensStatus <int>] [-AccessToken <SecureString>] [-AccessTokenUpdated <DateTimeOffset>] [-AccessExpiresIn <int>] [-RefreshToken <SecureString>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A media type is how Zabbix delivers a message: email, SMS, a script, or a webhook to a chat or ticketing system. The New-ZbxMediaType cmdlet sends mediatype.create with one request field per parameter, then reads the new media type back with mediatype.get and writes it. The server requires -Type and -Name; -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name and wins over a parameter. -WhatIf shows what would be created, and the command needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Create a media type

```powershell
New-ZbxMediaType -Name 'Mail relay' -Type Email -SmtpServer 'mail.example.com' -SmtpHelo 'example.com' -SmtpEmail 'zabbix@example.com'
```

Creates a media type named Mail relay. The command writes the new media type, read back from the server.
